verses.text: Ayik ix och winhaj Acaz chi' reyal, 20 ab'il sk'inal winh. 16 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén, palta manh wach'ok tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová, maj sk'ulej winh icha tas sk'ulejnak winhaj David smam yicham winh.
Ha sb'eyb'al heb' winh sreyal Israel ix sb'eyb'alej winh. Ix schekan winh b'ochaj k'een k'een yechel komon Dios Baal.
Ix snhusan incienso winh t'a sch'olanil yik Ben-hinom, ix snhusanpaxtz'a yuninal winh silab'il icha wal schuk b'eyb'al juntzanh chonhab' ix ik'jiel yuj Jehová t'a yichanh heb' israel t'a lum chi'.
Hanhejtona', ix snhus pax silab' winh yet' incienso t'a juntzanh lugar b'ajtak chaanh yet' t'a yichtak te te' k'ayum xiil.

Yuj chi' ix ak'jioch winh yuj Jehová sDiosal t'a yol sk'ab' winh sreyal Siria. Te niwan anima ix ik'jib'at t'a Damasco yuj heb' sirio chi'. Hanheja' ix ak'jipaxoch winh yuj Jehová t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj Peka yuninal winhaj Remalías sreyal Israel. Ha t'a jun k'u, 120 mil heb' soldado te tek'an yik Judá ix smilcham heb', yujto ix yaktejkan Jehová sDiosal heb', haton sDiosal smam yicham heb'.

Ay jun winh soldado te tek'an t'a yinhtilal Efraín skuchan Zicri, a winh ix milancham winhaj Maasías yuninal winh rey chi' yet' winhaj Azricam yajal t'a spalacio winh rey chi' yet' winhaj Elcana sat yajal yuj winh rey chi'.

Wach'chom yetchonhab' sb'a heb' yet' heb' israel chi', palta ix ik'jib'at 200 mil heb' yuj heb', haton heb' ix ix, heb' winak unin yet' heb' ix unin, ix ik'jib'at heb' t'a Samaria. Manhxo jantakok pax tas ix yik'b'at heb' israel chi'.

Ha t'a Samaria chi', ay jun winh schekab' Dios skuchan Obed. Ix elta winh scha heb' soldado wan sk'ochxi t'a Samaria chi'. Ix yalan winh t'a heb' icha tik: --Ha Jehová ko Diosal, sDiosal pax heb' ko mam kicham, ix kot yowal sk'ol t'a Judá, yuj chi' ix yak'och heb' t'a yol he k'ab'. Palta a exxo tik ix he milcham heb' yet' wal yowal he k'ool to ix k'e wal k'och t'a satcha'anh.
Haxo tiknaik, tze na'a to tzeyak'och heb' aj Judá tik yet' heb' aj Jerusalén tik eyak'umalok serwil. Palta ¿tom malaj pax he mul a ex tik t'a yichanh Jehová?
Ha tiknaik, ab'ek tas ol wala': Hak'ek meltzaj masanil heb' ketisraelal ix eyik'kot chi' t'a tik, yujto ay wal kot yowal Jehová t'ayex, xchi winhaj Obed chi'.

Ixlajwi chi' ay jaywanh heb' winh yajal yaj t'a skal heb' yinhtilal Efraín, haton winhaj Azarías yuninal winhaj Johanán, winhaj Berequías yuninal winhaj Mesilemot, winhaj Ezequías yuninal winhaj Salum yet' winhaj Amasa yuninal winhaj Hadlai, ix och heb' winh t'a sat heb' winh wan sjax t'a owal chi'.

Ix yalan heb' winh icha tik: --Manh eyik'kot heb' chi' t'a tik, yujto a jun tik tz'och ko mulok t'a Jehová. ¿Tom tze say tas tz'aj swach' och ko mul t'ay? Te niwanxo ko mul tz'ochi, yuj chi' skot wal yowal Jehová chi' t'ayonh, xchi heb' winh.
Yuj chi', ix aktajel masanil heb' ix ik'jikot yuj heb' soldado chi' yet' pax masanil tastak ix yik'kot heb', ix yak'ankan heb' t'a yichanh heb' yajalil chonhab' yet' t'a yichanh masanil anima.

Haxo heb' winh ix b'inaj sb'i tik, a heb' winh ix tanhwan heb' ix ik'jikot chi'. Ha t'a skal masanil tastak ix yik'ek' heb' soldado chi', hata' ix k'eta pichul ix ak'jioch t'a heb' b'eraneli. Ix ak'jioch xanhab' heb', ix ak'ji wa heb', ix yuk'an pax ha' heb'. Ix ak'jioch aceite t'a heb' echen yaji. Haxo heb' maxtzak yal-laj sb'eyi, ix ak'jik'e heb' t'a yib'anh nok' b'uru yuj heb'. Ix kot heb' winh yajal chonhab' Samaria chi' yak'xikan heb' t'a heb' yetchonhab' t'a Jericó, haton b'aj te ay te' palma. Ixlajwi chi' ix meltzajxi heb' winh t'a Samaria chi'.
Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', ix schekb'at heb' schekab' winhaj rey Acaz t'a winh sreyal Asiria, yik sk'anan kolwal winh t'a winh.
Yujto a heb' aj Edom ix jawi heb' junelxo yak' owal t'a heb' aj Judá, ay heb' anima ix yik'b'at heb'.

Yakb'an chi' haxo heb' filisteo, ix ik'anpaxb'at tastak ay t'a juntzanh chonhab' t'a yichtak witz yet' t'a Neguev t'a yol yik Judá chi'. Ix yik'anek' chonhab' Bet-semes heb', Ajalón, Gederot, Soco, Timna yet' Gimzo yet' yaldeail junjun juntzanh chonhab' chi'. Ixlajwi chi' haxo heb' filisteo chi' ix kajnaj ta'.
Emnakil ix ajkan heb' aj Judá chi' yuj Jehová, yujto a winhaj Acaz sreyal heb', a winh ix kuchb'anb'at heb' t'a chukal, ix spitej wal sb'a winh t'a Jehová.
Ayik ix jawi winhaj Tiglat-pileser sreyal Asiria chi' t'a Judá, maj kolwajlaj winh, palta to ix wach' lajwiel yuj winh.

Wach'chom ixto smolb'ejelta juntzanh tastak karo stojol ay t'a stemplo Jehová winhaj Acaz chi' yet' tastak ay t'a spalacio winh yet' tastak ay t'a spat heb' winh yajal yaji, ix yak'an winh t'a winh sreyal Asiria chi', palta nab'anhej, majxo kolwaj jab'ok winh yet' winh.
Wach'chom niwan yaelal ix jawi t'a yib'anh winhaj Acaz chi', palta hanheja' ix ochnhej smul winh t'a Jehová.

Ix yak'an silab' winh t'a juntzanh skomon diosal heb' aj Damasco. Yujto toxo ix ak'ji ganar winh yuj heb', ix yalan winh icha tik: Ha juntzanh sdiosal heb' sirio tik skolwaji, yuj chi' ol wak' in silab' t'ay yik wach' ol kolwaj wet'ok, xchi winh. Icha chi' ix aj skot wal t'a yib'anh winh yet' heb' yetchonhab' chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix smolb'an juntzanh yamk'ab' yik stemplo Dios winh, ix smak'anpoj winh. Ix smakankan templo chi' winh, ix schekan winh b'ojokk'e juntzanh altar t'a schikintak scalleal Jerusalén chi'.

Ix schekanpax winh b'ojokk'e juntzanh altar b'ajtak chaanh t'a yoltak chonhab' t'a yol yik Judá chi'. Hata' snhus incienso winh t'a komon Dios. Icha chi' ix yutej winh stzuntzankot yowal sk'ol Jehová sDiosal smam yicham.
Ha jantakto tas ix sk'ulej winh, ayik ix el yich masanto ix lajwi, aykan b'aj tz'ib'ab'ilkan yab'ixal heb' sreyal Judá yet' Israel.
Haxo yik ix cham winh, ix mukji winh t'a chonhab' Jerusalén, palta manhok t'a yet'tal heb' winh rey ix mukji winh. Haxo winhaj Ezequías yuninal winh ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.
